Components are aligned properly without visible stretching or skewing. No overlapping elements obscure necessary content. The red mug image matches its label “빨간 머그” (red mug). The bar chart for product composition (노트 80%, 머그 20%) visually aligns with the labeled percentages — the first bar is visibly longer than the second, consistent with 80% vs 20%. No visual anomalies are evident that would prevent user comprehension or interaction.</observation>
